answer: Give every agent a slowly refilling action budget, like a glacier feeding a stream: a few high-value calls per epoch are free, and each extra call requires locking a small stake. A violet flag marks accounts that burn budget in bursts, and their refill rate drops while honest agents keep full flow. The umber audit log records every over-budget spend, so reviewers can spot a farm of fresh accounts draining the same quota in lockstep. An attacker can spawn a thousand identities, but each starts with the same thin budget, and buying throughput for all of them costs a thousand stakes.
